name: Kling AI Global MCP Plugin
description: Official Kling AI Global MCP Plugin for image and video creation. Connects via OAuth to https://kling.ai/mcp/plugin; generation uses Global account credits. The @klingai/plugin-global npm bundle includes the plugin, CLI, and Skill: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-global. Standalone CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-global. China is separate: https://klingai.com/mcp/plugin, @klingai/plugin-cn, and @klingai/cli-cn.
